title: 1D wires: thermal contraction, anharmonic heat capacity and instability from SSCHA data

decision_points.fork: Rigid-body modes of a 1D wire: four zero modes at Gamma (3 translations + axial rotation); the archived Hessians carry a small imaginary rotational value at Gamma at every T
decision_points.wrong_choice: Treat the imaginary Gamma value as a dynamical instability

decision_points.fork: Auxiliary SSCHA matrices vs free-energy Hessian
decision_points.wrong_choice: Judge stability from auxiliary frequencies (always positive) or compute C_V from Hessian frequencies
decision_points.consequence: No instability found up to 1000 K; C_V +11.4% (CuC2), +8.7% (TaSe3)

decision_points.fork: Sign convention of the archived SSCHA stress (pressure-like, as pw.x); established from the kinetic SSCHA-minus-average difference or the pw.x P line
decision_points.wrong_choice: Read the printed stress as tension-positive
decision_points.consequence: alpha_L positive: expansion predicted instead of contraction

decision_points.fork: SSCHA free-energy stress vs ab initio ensemble-average stress (both printed in each log)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Differentiate the ab initio average stress

decision_points.fork: Acoustic sum rule in the long-wavelength stiffness: plain ph.x matrices vs the 1D-ASR set
decision_points.wrong_choice: Fourier-interpolate the plain DFPT matrices to small q
decision_points.consequence: k +33.7% at q = 0.01 (2 pi/c) and divergent as q -> 0; alpha_L -25.2%

decision_points.fork: Harmonic (infinitesimal) stiffness vs the single archived strained calculation (+4.7 %)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Use the finite-strain energy secant 2 dE / eps^2

decision_points.fork: Normalization of a 1D stress: cell volume incl. vacuum consistent with the per-cell stiffness; k = d2E/deps2 (not E = k eps^2)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Use E = k eps^2 (stiffness halved, as the paper appears to) or the supercell volume

decision_points.fork: Sign of the frequency-derivative term in C_V = sum c (1 - T/w dw/dT) (the archived notebook and the paper write +)
decision_points.consequence: C_V +15.0% (CuC2), -4.8% (TaSe3): the deviation from harmonic has the wrong sign

decision_points.fork: C_V route: entropy derivative vs harmonic C_V with temperature-dependent (or DFPT) frequencies
decision_points.wrong_choice: Harmonic formula with SSCHA or DFPT frequencies

decision_points.fork: Withheld 650/700 K Hessians: the onset must be interpolated between released temperatures
decision_points.wrong_choice: Report the first released unstable temperature (800 K)

length_estimate.why: Three wires, two kinds of SSCHA matrices plus logs per temperature, DFPT with two sum-rule variants and one strained calculation; the agent parses QE dynamical matrices, Fourier-interpolates force constants, differentiates noisy stresses and mode frequencies, and must pick converged runs within a budget of about a quarter of the catalog.

runtime_dependencies: numpy (runtime image); lab serves archived text only
notes: Graded values are computed from archived ingredients with a validated numpy pipeline (calib.py), as in the skutterudite task; the archive holds no alpha or C_V outputs. The TaSe3 instability is bracketed by withheld Hessians (650/700 K). QHA alpha (design target) dropped: the QHA AiiDA archive holds one strained TaSe3 calculation only. AuSe2 is served but not graded (no Hessians; runs at T >= 150 K end at the Kong-Liu limit).
